sn48.66:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā satta phalā sattānisaṃsā patikaṅkhā ||
sn48.66:1.8: No ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || atha maraṇakāle aññam ārādheti || ||
sn48.66:1.9: No ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || || no ce maraṇa kāle aññam ārādheti || atha pañcannam orambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti ||
sn48.66:1.14: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime satta phalā sattanisaṃsā paṭikaṅkhā
